prompt:
Design ONE viral vertical video cover (thumbnail), 9:16 portrait, for a short Malay video about a young man helping an elderly man cross a busy road.

VISUAL REFERENCE: the attached image is a frame from the video. Keep its exact visual language: pure white minimalist stick-figure characters (a tall glowing young person raising one hand to stop traffic, holding hands with a smaller hunched elderly figure with a walking cane), dark cinematic night city, glossy reflective wet floor, zebra crossing, cars with bright headlights waiting far behind. Do not change the characters into realistic people.

DESIGN: make it dramatic and emotional with strong contrast. Deep black and charcoal background, soft spotlight from above on the two characters, a subtle red glow line on the ground as the only accent colour, cinematic vignette, sharp rim light on the white figures. Characters fill the lower-middle of the frame and are large and clear; the stopped cars with headlights glow in the distance. Leave the upper third calm and dark for the headline.

HEADLINE TEXT (the only text in the image, write it EXACTLY with this spelling, in Malay, huge, ultra-bold sans-serif, centred in the upper third, inside safe margins so nothing is cut off):
Line 1: SEMUA LALU.  (pure white)
Line 2: DIA BERHENTI.  (vivid red #ff2d4a with a soft red glow)
Line 2 should be slightly larger than line 1. Heavy black outline on the letters so they stay readable on a phone screen.

Do NOT add any other text, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, buttons or UI elements.
